turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me, so start there.
Quick tangent. I'm negotiating my contract with the district next month.
Your contract is between you and the district. I'm here about Owen, and you still haven't told me why nobody called me before that zero went in.
You negotiate for a living. Give me three tips. Quick ones.
You want free counsel from the parent you just put in this chair? No. Who decided on that zero, Hale, and was Owen heard before it went into the gradebook?
